email.subject: Updated offer - Software Engineer at Larkspur Learning
email.body:
Hi,

Thanks for the open conversation yesterday. I spoke with the hiring manager, and we're able to improve our offer for the Software Engineer role:

- Base salary raised to 1,300,000 TRY
- A one-off signing bonus of 60,000 TRY
- Fully remote, with one team week in the office each quarter

The revised offer letter is attached. Let me know if this works for you.

Best,
Chloe Bennett
Recruiter, Larkspur Learning
